facts.value: Prepare to lead productive teams and projects to achieve organizational goals with this Bachelor of Arts in organizational leadership with a concentration in project management. In this program, you’ll learn about project initiation, planning, executing, controlling and closing at the organizational level. With a combination of theoretical knowledge and practical skills, you’ll graduate with transferable, in-demand skills sought by hiring managers.
